user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error message when I enter an invalid email format during registration so that I know to correct it.

positive.title: Valid email format registration
steps: Enter a valid email address (e.g., user@example.com)
Complete the registration form with valid data
positive.expected_result: User should be successfully registered without any error messages.

negative.title: Invalid email format registration
steps: Enter an invalid email address (e.g., user@.com)
Complete the registration form with valid data
negative.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating the email format is invalid.

edge.title: Email format with special characters
steps: Enter an email address with special characters (e.g., user#example.com)
Complete the registration form with valid data
edge.expected_result: An error message should be displayed indicating the email format is invalid.
